meta.description: Standard Model inputs for RG running (src/rg.py). Two blocks: raw PDG 2026 electroweak/QCD values, and the full-SM MSbar couplings at M_Z derived from PDG 2024 inputs by Antusch, Hinze, Saad (2025). The second block is a derived (two-loop matched) parameter set, used as the RG boundary condition for the gauge couplings, Higgs quartic and vev; fermion Yukawas are NOT taken from it (src/rg.py derives them from data/masses.json).

pdg2026.source: PDG 2026 Review of Particle Physics, 'Physical constants' table (rpp2026-rev-phys-constants.pdf) and Electroweak review Table 10.2 (rpp2026-rev-standard-model.pdf); M_H from PDG2026 API S126M

ahs2025_msbar_MZ.source: S. Antusch, K. Hinze, S. Saad, 'Updated running quark and lepton parameters at various scales', arXiv:2510.01312v2, Eq. (4) (2024 PDG inputs, full SM, top not decoupled) and text (v at mu = M_t)
ahs2025_msbar_MZ.convention: g1 in GUT normalisation g1^2 = (5/3) g'^2; lambda in the REAP convention V = (lambda/4)(H^dag H)^2, m_H^2 = lambda v^2 / 2 at tree level; m_f = y_f v / sqrt(2)

v_Mt.note: MSbar vev at mu = M_t quoted in the text of arXiv:2510.01312
